TASK: Adapt this ad into a square 1:1 version of itself, as the same brand designer would.

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Same dark espresso-brown background, same typography style, same circular background motifs.
- Keep the same text the ad already has: the wordmark 'QUILLFORD · COFFEE', the headline 'Your first bag is on us', the subline 'Fresh-roasted. Shipped the same week.', and the amber pill button 'Claim your bag'. Do not add or invent any new text.
- Re-compose natively for a square 1:1 canvas so it reads as designed for this shape, not cropped.

THE BOTTOM QUARTER OF THIS IMAGE MUST CONTAIN NO TEXT AT ALL.
The bottom 25% of the canvas has NO text. No words. No letters. No paragraphs. No small print. No disclaimer. No legal copy. Do NOT reproduce the small legal paragraph from the source image. That area is reserved for a human to add text later. Any text there is a failure.
IMPORTANT: fill that area by CONTINUING the existing background exactly as it appears elsewhere in the image, including the same colour gradient and the same circular motifs. It must blend seamlessly. Do NOT paint it as a flat block of solid colour and do NOT create any visible horizontal edge, seam, band, or change in tone anywhere in the image.
